Theta GmbH's strategy of filing for multiple patents on next-generation wireless communication is a high-impact move designed to establish a temporary monopoly. This will likely impede our development efforts by creating legal barriers to entry, forcing us to seek alternative solutions or engage in costly licensing negotiations. The primary implication for our business is a potential delay in product launches and increased R&D costs as we navigate around their intellectual property claims.
